custom_css: */ /* 禁用分类页二级菜单链接 */a[role="menuitem"]:is(.mega-menu-columns__heading) {pointer-events: none; cursor: default;}
/* 修改 "Size" 字段的字体大小为 13px */#po_label684877 span {font-size: 13px;}
/* 修改所有按钮的字体大小为 12px */.po-option__button-value {font-size: 12px;}
/* 影藏尺码必选提示*/.po-required {display: none;}
/* 影藏尺码选项选择后显示*/.swatch_value {display: none;}
.product-form__input-wrapper input[type="radio"]:checked + label {border: 1px solid black; /* 点击后的黑色边框 */}
/* 分类页主副标题价格间距*/.product-card--image-wrapper {margin-bottom: 5px;}
.product-card-info {display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 1200px; padding: 20px;}
/* 选择vendor链接 */.product-card-info .product-card-vendor a {pointer-events: none; /* 禁用点击事件 */ color: inherit; /* 保持原有颜色，避免链接颜色 */ text-decoration: none; /* 去掉下划线 */}
